policy: Official Elementor Help Center > official developer docs > CSS primary references > validated workbook fixtures > educational models

sources.title: Why Elementor is going CSS-first
claims: V4 emphasizes CSS fundamentals, inheritance, hierarchy, reusable Variables, Classes and States

sources.title: Elementor Editor 4.0 Developers Update
claims: V4 foundation includes Atomic Elements, Variables, Classes and Components
system-based workflow targets consistency and scale

sources.title: Units of measurement
claims: Elementor documents px, em, rem, percentage, vw and vh
unit availability is contextual

sources.title: Variables
claims: A variable is a nickname/reference for a value
variables can be used across a site and inside classes

sources.title: Variables Manager
claims: Official variable types are exactly Color, Font and Size

sources.title: How to import and export design systems
claims: Variables and classes export as one ZIP
individual selective import is unavailable
name conflicts are handled by replace or keep existing

sources.title: How to sync variables and global elements
claims: Atomic variables can sync to V3 Global Colors or Global Fonts
font syncing is limited to Typography

sources.title: Classes in Elementor
claims: Every element has a Local Class
Global Classes are reusable
Local properties can be converted to a Global Class

sources.title: Prioritize conflicting styles
claims: The leftmost class has priority
Local Class is always leftmost and highest in Elementor class hierarchy

sources.title: The Elementor Editor Class Manager
claims: Reordering Global Classes changes their priority

sources.title: Element states
claims: A State is edited for the selected class in the Style tab

sources.title: Components
claims: Components use Atomic Elements
creation and editing require Elementor Pro and Admin-level permissions
only eligible General-tab fields with the property icon can be customized
Instance overrides persist after Master updates
Detach Component is supported
Component nesting remains insufficient_evidence in this package

sources.title: Dynamic tags in V4
claims: V4 provides Post Custom Field and other official Dynamic Tags

sources.title: Elementor Integration With ACF
claims: Supported ACF fields can be selected through Dynamic controls
fields omitted from the supported list, including repeater, are unsupported at the review date

sources.title: Loop Grid widget
claims: Loop Grid uses a template and Query controls
Source, Include and Exclude control displayed items

sources.title: Create queries
claims: Query Source determines data type
Include and Exclude filter results

sources.title: Interactions
claims: Triggers include Page Load, Scroll Into View, While Scrolling, On Hover and On Click
Effects include Fade, Slide and Scale
Types are In and Out
Duration and Delay are milliseconds
multiple interactions can be added to one element

sources.title: CSS values and units
claims: CSS values include numbers, dimensions, percentages, keywords, functions and references

sources.title: CSS length data type
claims: rem is root-font-relative
em is font-relative
vw/vh/dvh are viewport-relative
dvh is a CSS unit and is not asserted as exposed in every Elementor control
